Trigger You Break the Anchor against a Named target.

Area 30-foot emanation

Saving Throw Will

The break is audible to everything that shares its condition. Each hostile spirit or ghost-machine other than the target within the area must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or become frightened 1; on a critical failure it is frightened 2 and slowed 1 for 1 round. The Named target itself is unaffected — it has troubles of its own.
